payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP over length and last change position, with equality constraints merged via union-find and type-2 constraints enforcing a minimum last change index.
payload.rationale: The solution iteratively builds DP table d[i][j] where i is prefix length and j is the index of the last character flip. It incorporates forced equalities via parent array and enforces diversity constraints by restricting the allowed last flip position.
